A complete frame keeps the observation, its context, the information used to interpret it, the derived state, and its lineage connected. The delivery envelope carries that evidence through the network.

This is an explanatory view of the actual application result. The scientific NMF contract in the documents is broader than the local implementation. Planned fields and missing evidence are identified explicitly. Simulated September 10 timestamps are generator coordinates, not a claim of future physical collection.

What belongs in the complete frame

The documented scientific record is Fₜ = (Iₜ, Tₜ, Sₜ, Cₜ, Rₜ, Φₜ, Xₜ, Qₜ, Pₜ, Yₜ). Priors and derived interpretations belong in typed context and parent-linked records. A transport envelope wraps the payload; it does not replace the science record.

The full collection surface: six physical modalities plus context

A scalar feature is not a replacement for the raw waveform or image. On physical devices, retain raw-window references, engineering units and sensor-specific calibration.

1. Collected sensor values

These are the exact scalar inputs in the frozen synthetic observation, before the model interprets them.

Exact original observation


2. Prior information used by this inference
No external knowledge was retrieved for this run. Bundled source documents are searchable by MYCA, but availability in the app does not mean a document was consumed by the detector. MINDEX records, environmental maps, species references and prior experiments would need explicit retrieval IDs, versions, valid times and evidence links.
Previous observations from the same source
Frozen model: all parameters and prototypes
Current 24-dimensional readout input
First 16: native representation. Next 7: recursive smoothing of the first seven native channels (0.55 current + 0.45 previous smoothed state). Last: absolute IAQ-coordinate difference from the prior smoothed state. The fitted readout adds a bias parameter, giving 25 weights.


3. Sensor fusion and counterevidence
Within one observation, the native encoder combines scalar channels. Across observations, this local experiment computes the mean score of concurrent independent source/modality neighbors. It then applies fused = sequence × (0.4 + 0.6 × neighbor_mean). This is a fixed reference rule, not the planned SSM/hypergraph/attention backbone.
Neighbors share a capture and a 10-second observation bucket. Source ID, modality and origin must differ. Disagreement is retained; multiplying confidence scores is not evidence of statistical independence.
Typed graph links involving this observation
These are inferred pair scores with observation IDs. They use temporal evidence and spatial proximity. Evaluation labels shown in these records are attached after inference.


4. Form State, quality and the declared goal
All 16 native coordinates and their meaning
Policy and advisory evidence window
The declared goal and resource envelope influence advisory review. They do not manufacture sensor evidence. This observation may be older than the run's final advisory window.
The local target is the mean training representation of background observations. Its distance and per-step distance change are dimensionless. This implementation does not establish a biological attractor, physical velocity, a target-manifold posterior, or a validated intervention forecast.
Separate evaluation truth — excluded from inference inputs


5. The rooted run and the proof of origin
This app binds configuration, computed products and observations into a run-level root. It does not currently serialize every scientific NMF field as one full RootedNatureFrame object.
Inclusion proof for the initial example
This included proof is specifically for test-020-mushroom-1 among all 960 records. It was independently recomputed during assembly of this inspector.
Existing signed export manifest and public signature
The signature applies to the original exported manifest, not to this explanatory HTML. Root/signature integrity does not establish calibration, physical truth, or external trust in the included public key. Private keys are not included.


6. The packet that moves through the network
The science payload and the delivery envelope are different objects. A payload hash identifies exact bytes; it does not carry those bytes or make them recoverable if no node retains them.
Full proposed DIRTNet envelope and implementation boundary
Collection policy: retain raw data locally; send compact events and evidence handles when bandwidth is constrained; request raw blocks or detailed windows when needed; preserve deduplication identity through relays; append transformations as new derived records. Exactly which blocks are transmitted should be explicit in each message profile.


Why the frame has value
Scientific reuse
A future model can revisit the original measurement, calibration and conditions instead of inheriting only an old label.
Decision relevance
Time, place, history and independent evidence make a sensor change interpretable. Missingness and disagreement remain visible.
Efficient verification
Compact claims can travel with evidence handles while retained raw records support audit and replay. Repeated relay copies add no independent evidence.
For the ITDX demonstration: identify the record, inspect the raw channels, show the prior model and temporal memory, follow corroborating and conflicting observations, inspect the Form State and age rules, then show the transmitted message and its retained source evidence.
